command.name: security key-manager external gcp update-config
command.description: This command allows the user to update the configuration file used by the Google Cloud Key Management Service (GCKMS) configured for the given Vserver. The configuration is initialized by running the security key-manager external gcp enable command. This command will fail if GCKMS has not been enabled for the Vserver.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver for which the GCKMS configuration will be updated.

parameter.name: port
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the port of the deployed GCKMS.

parameter.name: oauth-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Open-Authorization and Identity Access and Management Host of the deployed GCKMS.

parameter.name: gcp-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Host Subdomain of the deployed GCKMS.

parameter.name: privileged-account
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify a privileged service account (email address) with both cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncrypt and cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt permissions. If this parameter is specified, any calls made to the GCKMS will first use iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken to impersonate the privileged account.

parameter.name: authentication-method
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the authentication method.

parameter.name: gce-metadata-server
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the custom Google Cloud Engine Metadata Server address used for authentication.

example.p: The following example updates the GCKMS configuration for the data Vserver v1 with a new port number 2333, a new authentication endpoint "oauth2.googleapis.com", a new privileged account "serviceaccount@myproject.com" and a new service endpoint "cloudkms.googleapis.com".
example.screen: cluster-1::> security key-manager external gcp update-config -vserver v1 -port 2333 -oauth-host oauth2.googleapis.com -privileged-account serviceaccount@myproject.com -gcp-host cloudkms.googleapis.com
